evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic warning framing unrehearsed rollback as worthless — urgency-as-worry delivered through a stark equivalence claim.
Settled, matter-of-fact cadence declaration — low arousal, positive valence of a decision made and owned.
Plain ownership attribution — calm acceptance of responsibility, no heightened affect.

mints.name: StarkEquivalenceWarning
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker crystallizing a risk into a stark equivalence that makes the warning feel self-evident?
